description: This file defines the EmailService class in a Java Spring application, managing email mailbox operations including listing, searching, composing, sending, and updating email flags within the email module.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Service class managing email-related operations such as listing, searching, composing, sending, and updating emails.

methods.name: listInbox
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of emails in the inbox folder for a specific user.

methods.name: listSent
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of sent emails for a specific user.

methods.name: listDrafts
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of draft emails for a specific user.

methods.name: listTrash
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of trashed emails for a specific user.

methods.name: listArchived
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of archived emails for a specific user.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search across email subjects and bodies for a specific user based on a query string.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Fetches details of a single email by ID for a specific user.

methods.name: saveDraft
methods.description: Saves a draft email owned by the current user.

methods.name: composeAndSend
methods.description: Composes and sends an email, including internal delivery to recipients.

methods.name: deliverToRecipients
methods.description: Handles internal delivery of emails to recipient users within the database.

methods.name: updateFlags
methods.description: Updates flags such as read, starred, archived, and deleted for an email.
